answer: What actually deters a farm is signed podcast listening receipts with platform attestation. A podcast platform signs receipts proving the account listened to full episodes over thirty days. A farm must stream hours of audio per copy, and bulk playback from one IP collapses the receipts into one pattern. The wander is a small, unavoidable expense per identity; multiply it by ten thousand copies and the sonnet dwarfs any epoch payout. The glacier is simple: make the copy cost more than the copy earns.
